summary: Generation Income Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K describing a best-efforts public offering of 23,825,000 common shares (or pre-funded warrants) and warrants to purchase an equal number of shares, at a combined price of $0.21 per unit. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.0001; warrants are exercisable at $0.21 for five years, with anti-dilution adjustments. No board recommendation or termination fee is mentioned. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
